tenderSchedule.description: RFP FOR SELECTION OF ONE AGENCY FOR EACH OF THE 5-CITY CORPORATIONS FOR DOOR-TO-DOOR DWELLING UNIT SURVEY, GPS GEO-TAGGING, COLLECTION OF DWELLING UNIT INFORMATION & DOOR-STEP DELIVERY OF EKHATAS IN THE GREATER BENGALURU AREA

tenderAddress.blockNumber: Meeting Hall, IT Section, GBA Head Office, behind Glass House, 1st Floor, NR Square, Bengaluru-560002

tenderEligibilityCriterionList.description: Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: The bidder must have successfully executed one or a maximum of two field survey/check works, which individually or collectively have a contract value of not less than 2.5 Crores (Rupees Two Crores Fifty Lakhs Only), for any Government Department, Government Agency, or Government-owned Public Sector Undertaking (PSU) during the last three years

The bidder must have successfully completed any field survey/check work by deploying not less than 100 persons for any government department or government agency or government owned PSU in the last three years. The proof of successful completion shall be furnished in the form of the workorder and certificate of successful completion of the assigned work
The Bidder must be a company registered under Indian Companies Act or the Partnership Act
Bidder should be registered under GST
The bidders should not be a defaulter or a blacklisted firm in respect of any tender or contract in any of the Government departments/authorities/PSUs or companies

The bidder should have an average turnover of Rs 5 Crores in the three financial Years viz 2022-23, 2023-24, 2024-25 as evidenced by the audited accounts of the company (the CA certified and audited turnover for 2025-26 will also be accepted for the purpose of fulfillment of this clause instead of 2022-23).
